textos.Muitas reviews negativas descrevem o fil: Many negative reviews describe the film as anxiety-inducing, with a constantly tense atmosphere that, although intentional, was felt as unpleasant and wearing.

textos.Várias reviews medianas relatam que o fi: Several middling reviews report that the film causes a constant state of tension and anxiety, with a fast pace and overlapping dialogue that leave the viewer exhausted, although some acknowledge that this was the intention.

textos.Este grupo destaca a atuação de Adam San: This group highlights Adam Sandler's performance as a high point, praising his ability to play a detestable, intense character, although some reviews consider it overrated or repetitive.
textos.Muitas reviews medianas apontam que o fi: Many middling reviews point out that the film becomes long and drawn out at several moments, especially in the middle, with scenes that seem to lead nowhere and make time pass slowly.

textos.Diversas reviews comentam que, apesar do: Several reviews comment that, despite the chaos and tension, they could not engage emotionally with the protagonist or the plot, finding it hard to root for him or care about what happens.
textos.O desfecho é frequentemente citado como: The ending is often cited as surprising and intense, with some people saying it raises their final rating, while others feel it makes the preceding experience pointless or does not make up for the rest of the film.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas mencionam a pre: Some middling reviews mention the presence of Julia Fox and Kevin Garnett as curious or positive points, but there is also criticism of Garnett's performance and of the lack of development of the secondary characters.
textos.As reviews positivas descrevem o filme c: Positive reviews describe the film as an intense, anguishing experience that keeps the viewer on alert from start to finish, comparing it to a panic attack or an emotional roller coaster.
textos.Este grupo elogia a atuação de Adam Sand: This group praises Adam Sandler's performance, considering it one of the best of his career, highlighting his ability to play a dramatic, complex character, far from his usual comic roles.

textos.A trilha sonora e o desenho de som são m: The score and sound design are mentioned as elements that intensify the experience, with overlapping dialogue and a sound mix that contributes to the sense of urgency and chaos.

textos.Lançado em 2019 e dirigido por Benny Saf: Released in 2019 and directed by Benny Safdie, Uncut Gems is a crime drama and thriller centered on Howard Ratner, a charismatic New York jeweler accustomed to seeking financial gain through risky bets. When he glimpses the chance at a big payoff, he must balance his business dealings, family demands and the constant approach of debt collectors and adversaries.
textos.A experiência do filme é marcada por uma: The film's experience is marked by an atmosphere of uninterrupted tension and stress, built on a fast pace and overlapping dialogue that maintain a continuous sense of agitation.
textos.Os diferentes grupos de avaliação aborda: The different rating groups address essentially the same elements of the work, diverging in the final verdict on how well those choices work. In the vast majority of ratings (~81%), most highlight the constant tension and anxiety as marked features of the narrative. A large portion of this same segment stress Adam Sandler's dramatic performance, while a significant share emphasize the Safdie brothers' direction and style in handling the pace.
textos.Para quem está numa fração mínima das no: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~14%), the perception is divided: several point to the anxiety and stress generated as the predominant reaction to the film, and a considerable number examine Sandler's dramatic performance, although many indicate discomfort with a drawn-out pace and the film's running time.
textos.Já na leitura presente numa fração ainda: In the reading found in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~5%), a good portion reject the pace as excessively frantic and tiring. In addition, a significant share of this group complain of unlikable, shallow characters, while a smaller slice criticize the protagonist's behavior and the succession of erratic decisions throughout the story.
